classification.difficultyReason: Select suitable rectangle/triangle/trapezium/parallelogram/circle partitions across six supplied composite figures, infer missing component measures and exclude internal seams for perimeter; familiar linked formulas with exact pi.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter and area of each of these figures. Give answers to d, e and f in terms of $\pi$.

spec.description: Six-sided figure: upper equal15cm slopes, vertical14cm sides parallel, lower equal20cm slopes; symmetric dashed axis and equal/parallel inner15cm slopes. Halfwidth12cm, upper-to-shoulder23cm, lowerheight16cm original dimensions and extensions retained.
spec.mathematics: Six-sided figure: upper equal15cm slopes, vertical14cm sides parallel, lower equal20cm slopes; symmetric dashed axis and equal/parallel inner15cm slopes. Halfwidth12cm, upper-to-shoulder23cm, lowerheight16cm original dimensions and extensions retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Source givens and meaningful marks only; no calculated answers.

answer.worked:
The boundary is $P=2(15+14+20)=98\text{ cm}$. The width is $2(12)=24\text{ cm}$; the top triangle height is $23-14=9\text{ cm}$. Divide into the middle rectangle and top/bottom triangles:
$$A=24(14)+\frac12(24)(9)+\frac12(24)(16)=336+108+192=636\text{ cm}^2.$$

spec.description: Irregular pentagon boundary5,2,5,6,10cm. Dashed8cm altitude perpendicular6cm side and parallel2cm side; full horizontal span10cm dimension. All original labels/marks retained.
spec.mathematics: Irregular pentagon boundary5,2,5,6,10cm. Dashed8cm altitude perpendicular6cm side and parallel2cm side; full horizontal span10cm dimension. All original labels/marks retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Source givens and meaningful marks only; no calculated answers.

answer.worked: $P=5+2+5+6+10=28\text{ cm}$. The triangle to the right has base $6\text{ cm}$ and height $8\text{ cm}$, so area $24\text{ cm}^2$. The left trapezium has parallel sides $2$ and $8\text{ cm}$, separated by $10-6=4\text{ cm}$, so area $\frac12(2+8)4=20\text{ cm}^2$. Total $A=24+20=44\text{ cm}^2$.

spec.description: Eight equal5mm outer sides, two dashed internal horizontal dividers, central rightangle; total perpendicularheight13mm. No extra component-height givens.
spec.mathematics: Eight equal5mm outer sides, two dashed internal horizontal dividers, central rightangle; total perpendicularheight13mm. No extra component-height givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Source givens and meaningful marks only; no calculated answers.

answer.worked: All eight boundary intervals are $5\text{ mm}$, giving $P=8(5)=40\text{ mm}$. Each component has base $5\text{ mm}$, and their perpendicular heights add to $13\text{ mm}$. Thus $A=5(13)=65\text{ mm}^2$.

spec.description: Semicircle joined to2cm-wide10cm-high rectangle; internal verticaldiameter and centrepoint retained.
spec.mathematics: Semicircle joined to2cm-wide10cm-high rectangle; internal verticaldiameter and centrepoint retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Source givens and meaningful marks only; no calculated answers.

answer.worked: The semicircle radius is $5\text{ cm}$. Exclude its internal diameter from the perimeter: $P=10+2+2+5\pi=14+5\pi\text{ cm}$. Add component areas: $A=2(10)+\frac12\pi(5)^2=20+12.5\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

spec.description: Two semicircles diameter10cm plus centralrectangle width2cm, both dashed diameters and centres retained.
spec.mathematics: Two semicircles diameter10cm plus centralrectangle width2cm, both dashed diameters and centres retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Source givens and meaningful marks only; no calculated answers.

answer.worked: The two semicircles make one circle of radius $5\text{ cm}$. Only the two horizontal rectangle edges are exposed, so $P=2+2+2\pi(5)=4+10\pi\text{ cm}$. Area $A=2(10)+\pi(5)^2=20+25\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

spec.description: Quadrant radius3cm above right3by3 rectangle, left4by6 rectangle; fullheight6cm,leftwidth4cm and allthree3cm segments retained.
spec.mathematics: Quadrant radius3cm above right3by3 rectangle, left4by6 rectangle; fullheight6cm,leftwidth4cm and allthree3cm segments retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Source givens and meaningful marks only; no calculated answers.

answer.worked: The exposed straight sides total $6+4+3+7=20\text{ cm}$; the quadrant arc is $\frac14(2\pi\times3)=1.5\pi\text{ cm}$. Hence $P=20+1.5\pi\text{ cm}$. Add the left rectangle, lower-right square and quadrant: $A=4(6)+3(3)+\frac14\pi(3)^2=33+2.25\pi\text{ cm}^2$.
